description: The 17 United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) adopted in 2015 as a universal call to action to end poverty, protect the planet, and ensure prosperity for all by 2030.

goals.name: No Poverty
goals.description: End poverty in all its forms everywhere. Poverty encompasses lack of income and productive resources to ensure sustainable livelihoods.
targets: Eradicate extreme poverty (less than $2.15/day)
Reduce at least by half the proportion of people living in poverty
Implement social protection systems and measures for all
businessApplications: Fair wage policies and living wage commitments
Supply chain practices that uplift smallholders
Affordable products and services for base-of-pyramid markets

goals.name: Zero Hunger
goals.description: End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition, and promote sustainable agriculture.
targets: End hunger and ensure access to safe and nutritious food
End all forms of malnutrition
Double agricultural productivity and incomes of small-scale food producers
businessApplications: Supporting smallholder farmers in supply chains

goals.name: Good Health and Well-being
goals.description: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.
targets: Reduce maternal mortality and end preventable deaths of newborns
End epidemics and combat diseases
Achieve universal health coverage

goals.name: Quality Education
goals.description: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.
targets: Ensure all children complete quality primary and secondary education
Equal access to affordable technical and higher education
Substantially increase the number of youth and adults with relevant skills

goals.name: Gender Equality
goals.description: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls.
targets: End all forms of discrimination against women and girls
Ensure women's full and effective participation in leadership
Ensure universal access to reproductive health and rights
businessApplications: Products and services addressing women's needs

goals.name: Clean Water and Sanitation
goals.description: Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.
targets: Achieve universal and equitable access to safe drinking water
Achieve access to adequate sanitation and hygiene
Improve water quality by reducing pollution

goals.name: Affordable and Clean Energy
goals.description: Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all.
targets: Ensure universal access to affordable and reliable energy
Increase the share of renewable energy
Double the global rate of improvement in energy efficiency
businessApplications: Off-grid energy solutions for underserved areas

goals.name: Decent Work and Economic Growth
goals.description: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all.
targets: Sustain per capita economic growth
Achieve higher levels of economic productivity through innovation
Promote development-oriented policies for productive activities and decent job creation
businessApplications: Fair labor practices and living wages

goals.name: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
goals.description: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation.
targets: Develop quality, reliable and resilient infrastructure
Promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization
Enhance scientific research and upgrade industrial technologies

goals.name: Reduced Inequalities
goals.description: Reduce inequality within and among countries.
targets: Progressively achieve income growth of the bottom 40%
Empower and promote social, economic and political inclusion
Ensure equal opportunity and reduce inequalities of outcome

goals.name: Sustainable Cities and Communities
goals.description: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.
targets: Ensure access to adequate, safe and affordable housing
Provide access to sustainable transport systems
Reduce the adverse environmental impact of cities

goals.name: Responsible Consumption and Production
goals.description: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns.
targets: Implement the 10-year framework on sustainable consumption and production
Achieve sustainable management and efficient use of natural resources
Halve per capita global food waste at retail and consumer levels

goals.name: Climate Action
goals.description: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.
targets: Strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards
Integrate climate change measures into policies and planning
Improve education and awareness on climate change
businessApplications: Carbon footprint reduction and net-zero targets

goals.name: Life Below Water
goals.description: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas and marine resources for sustainable development.
targets: Prevent and reduce marine pollution
Sustainably manage and protect marine ecosystems
End overfishing and destructive fishing practices

goals.name: Life on Land
goals.description: Protect, restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, manage forests sustainably, combat desertification, and halt biodiversity loss.
targets: Ensure conservation of terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems
Promote sustainable forest management
Combat desertification and restore degraded land

goals.name: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
goals.description: Promote peaceful and inclusive societies, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable institutions.
targets: Significantly reduce all forms of violence
Promote the rule of law and ensure equal access to justice
Develop effective, accountable and transparent institutions

goals.name: Partnerships for the Goals
goals.description: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development.
targets: Enhance global macroeconomic stability
Enhance policy coherence for sustainable development
Enhance the global partnership for sustainable development
